draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the unseen test set of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: The evidence only covers the unseen test set of the same Banking and Travel domains used in training; no other customer-service domain was evaluated. The claim's generalization to "domains not seen in training" is unsupported. A defensible narrower claim is that Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on the held-out test set of the trained domains.
